card.name: Quantity words before measure or amount
card.fires_on: Quantity-type words such as few, large, considerable, small, certain or than that come right before a noun like measure, amount, share or portion. The pole responds on the quantifier, not the noun.

modes.label: Size words before amount nouns
modes.description: An adjective of degree after 'a' or 'in' that leads into amount, share, portion or measure.
modes.example: underwent a<< considerable>> amount of modification and extinction

modes.description: The word 'large' in the phrase 'in large measure'.

modes.label: Other quantity phrases
modes.description: Words in rate or comparison phrases such as 'per minute' or 'more than'.
modes.example: 4 beats<< per>> minute. The maximum decrease in blood pressure

card.plain: It fires on a size or degree word when the next word is likely 'measure' or an amount word.
